_doc: Per-game tile categorization and ability table for Robot Wants Kitty. Consumed by the TileMapAnalyzer frontend module. Sources: ~/CC/jpexs/output/robotkitty/scripts/xplor/{Player.as, PlayState.as, Missile.as}. The analyzer treats the raw byte stream from the SWF binary asset and maps each tile id to a category here. Multiple raw ids that share runtime behavior (e.g. all solid stone variants) map to the same category.

air._doc: Empty tile. Player passes through, no floor.

hazard_acid._doc: Acid. Player dies on contact (Player.as: Die() if tile in 16..23). Tile id 6 is the spawn marker that PlayState.LoadMap transforms into 16 or 20 at runtime; v1 treats it as the same hazard.

save_point._doc: Save point. Both 30 (inactive) and 31 (active/respawn) have the same traversal meaning.

player_start._doc: Player initial spawn marker (255). PlayState.LoadMap clears it to air at runtime; we treat it as air for traversal but keep the marker for the analyzer to find the start location.

goal_kitty._doc: Kitty (the rescue target, tile 254). PlayState.LoadMap clears the tile and spawns a Kitty sprite. Win condition is touching the kitty sprite. We model it as a location.

enemy_alien._doc: Enemy spawn (Alien). PlayState clears the tile to 0 at load time and spawns the enemy sprite. v1 treats as air; later versions will model enemies as obstacles.

enemy_boss._doc: Boss spawn (tile 14). v1 treats as air. Boss could later become a location if we add bossfight modeling.

floor_solid._doc: Solid stone wall. Tiles 50-54 (50 is the base; PlayState transforms 2x2 blocks of 50 into the 51/52/53/54 quad-variant randomly). Music zone 0.

floor_solid_yellow._doc: Yellow stone wall variants. 58 is the base; PlayState transforms 58 to 59-62 if surrounded by other yellows. Music zone 1.

floor_solid_third._doc: Third-color stone wall (63 base, randomized to 63-65). Music zone 2.

destructible_brick._doc: Tile 66. Destroyed by a missile collision (Missile.hitTop: clears the 3x3 around the impact for any tile == 66). Treated as a solid wall that the missile ability turns into air.

door_red._doc: Tile 55. Red door. Contiguous vertical column, opened by walking into it with red key (Player.hitWall).

door_green._doc: Tile 56. Green door, opened by green key.

door_blue._doc: Tile 57. Blue door, opened by blue key.

unknown._doc: Catch-all for raw byte values not present in tile_ids. Rendered loudly so missing mappings are visually obvious. Treated as solid for safety so the analyzer doesn't try to walk through an unidentified tile.

tile_ids._doc: Raw byte value -> category name. Any byte not listed here uses default_category.

_doc_fall_distance: Maximum vertical drop in tiles the analyzer will model for a 'fall' from a floor tile. Used only by the v1 bounding-box reachability approximation. 12 is chosen to cover the tallest vertical gap on Kitty's map (the map is 84 tiles tall and platforms are typically ~8 apart). Phase 6's physics model will replace this with a real integrator.

walk._doc: Move horizontally across adjacent floor tiles.

jump._doc: Basic jump: 2 tiles vertical (2.5 rounded down), 5 tiles horizontal from a floor tile. Measured from in-game reach. Per the user's instruction, treated as a basic ability (the player is assumed to start with jump already collected).

double_jump._doc: Double jump: 5 tiles vertical (user-measured), 8 tiles horizontal (reasonable middle-ground guess pending refinement).

rocket._doc: Vertical boost from ducking. v1 treats as a taller reach-extender (5 tiles vertical, 2 tiles horizontal) — rocket has less horizontal reach than jump because the player must duck first. Refinement deferred.

dash._doc: Long horizontal dash. v1 treats as a reach-extender (2 tiles vertical, 10 tiles horizontal). Dash moves at 5x run speed for 1 second, so it covers far more horizontal ground than jump. Refinement deferred.

shoot._doc: Shoots enemies. v1 has no effect (enemies are not modeled as obstacles in v1). Listed for completeness; later versions will add enemy_shootable transforms.

rapid_fire._doc: Faster shooting. v1 has no traversal effect.

missile._doc: Destroys destructible_brick tiles (id 66). Modeled as turning destructible_brick into air.

movement_models._doc: Reference list of the movement primitives the analyzer needs to support. Implemented in reachabilityAnalyzer.js. The 'jump_DV_DH' shorthand means 'from a floor tile, reach any walkable tile within DV vertical and DH horizontal tiles'. The union of all enabled movement primitives in the current ability set is taken.
